title: Dsl Migration Lock Step: Compiler-Enforced DocumentApp Bounds and Shared Infra
description:
Final "Lock step" of the dsl/ derive-engine migration: every technology's Projection now implements vcs::DocumentDsl and every Operation implements vcs::OpText via #[derive(dsl::DslDocument)]/#[derive(dsl::DslOps)] etc. This ticket makes that property compiler-enforced and wires up the last shared infrastructure:
1. Add `+ vcs::DocumentDsl` / `+ vcs::OpText` bounds to `DocumentApp` trait in framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs (~line 3101) - the compiler-enforced completeness gate. Fix any resulting compile errors (convert missed crates or document as follow-up).
2. Convert vcs/rs/lib.rs's own DemoProjection/DemoOperation test fixtures from hand-rolled DocumentDsl/OpText impls onto the dsl:: derive engine.
3. framework/sync/rs/lib.rs FolderEndpoint: add Text variant wired to vcs::FolderTextStorage, migrate FileJsonStorage dependents (framework/sync, framework/product/os/core), delete FileJsonStorage from vcs/rs/lib.rs.
4. PluginApp trait (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs ~3264): add document_text/load_document_text (+ possibly ingest_operations_text) text-based methods; update framework/wit/world.wit with -text WIT counterparts.
5. script.ts 🔖Policy region: forbid new */example/*.json files, add basic .ops grammar lint, add completeness check recognizing derive(dsl::Dsl*) attributes.
6. Regenerate framework/plugin/registry (bun script.ts generate) and confirm bun script.ts check passes.
7. launch.json: only touch if a new interactive dev command is introduced.
8. Optional: HistoryView.recent_ops field via OpText::print_op (low priority).
9. Renderer documentJson->documentDsl TS rename (lowest priority, likely deferred).
Final verification: cargo build --workspace, cargo test --workspace (or representative subset), bun script.ts verify. Known unrelated pre-existing failures to ignore: ui/wgpu icon_name catalog test, framework/product/os/core concurrent_delete_and_wire_reconciles_without_a_dangling_edge, draw/plugin marquee-select geometry bug, flow_core neural_cache_persists_across_evaluations.
summary:
Completed the dsl/ migration Lock step (items 1-6, 8 fully done and verified; item 7 confirmed no-op; item 9 explicitly deferred). Full `cargo build --workspace` is clean; every touched/fixed crate's `cargo test` passes except confirmed pre-existing/unrelated failures (icon-catalog panics from a concurrent ui/wgpu session, the 4 explicitly-flagged known bugs, plus 2 newly-discovered-but-clearly-unrelated ones: forms-plugin's try_wizard test and os-core's export_coverage test order flakiness).

1. DONE — Added `+ vcs::DocumentDsl` / `+ vcs::OpText` to `DocumentApp::Projection`/`Operation` bounds in framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs (~3101). This surfaced real compile errors, all fixed:
   - protocol/module/procedural (ModuleRenderPayload/ModulePayloadOperation never converted) → added #[derive(dsl::DslDocument)]/#[derive(dsl::DslOps)], added dsl dependency, added round-trip tests.
   - vcs/plugin (VcsDemoProjection/VcsDemoOperation never converted) → same treatment, added dsl dependency, added round-trip tests.
   - puzzle/plugin (Puzzle2d/3d/5dPlayApp keep Projection=serde_json::Value by pre-existing deliberate design, per puzzle_2d's own 🔖ValueBridge comment) → added a generic `impl vcs::DocumentDsl for serde_json::Value` in vcs/rs/lib.rs (schema-less escape hatch, mirrors the existing `dsl::DslField for serde_json::Value` impl) rather than retrofitting puzzle-plugin's 11k-line Value-based scene layer.
   - fem/plugin, trinity/plugin: fixed real call-site breakage from other recent same-wave conversions (Box<FemElement> wrapping, Dof→FemDof conversions, Vec<(String,f64)>→FemCombinationTerm/BTreeMap, HashMap→BTreeMap+LayoutPoint in trinity_rewrite_engine and trinity/plugin) — pre-existing but only surfaced by a full build.
   - Also fixed unrelated pre-existing build/test breaks blocking a clean build/test pass: dag-plugin/fem-plugin missing AppLabelsOverlay.tutorial_labels field; forms-plugin BlockPaletteEntry/UiTreeItemNode icon_id String→IconName; protocol/module/procedural window_kind() missing new icon_id arg; framework/schema's generated.rs using `//!` inside an `include!()`-spliced non-root position (fixed at the codegen source in framework/schema/script.ts); framework/plugin's own #[cfg(test)] DummyProjection/TestProjection/TestOperation fixtures (added dsl dev-dependency + derives), missing IconName import, stale UiTreeNode.selected_ids test assertion, stale world3d_projection_spec_json nested-shape test; framework/product/os/core missing AppDefinition.tutorials field at 5 call sites; framework/sync's own Demo test fixture missing `Operation` trait import.
   Verified via `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-lockstep-target cargo build --workspace` (clean) and per-crate `cargo test -p <crate>` for every crate touched.

2. DONE — Converted vcs/rs's own DemoProjection/DemoOperation test fixtures from hand-rolled DocumentDsl/OpText impls to `#[derive(dsl::DslDocument)]`/`#[derive(dsl::DslOps)]`. Added `dsl` as a dev-dependency in vcs/rs/Cargo.toml (dev-dep avoids the vcs↔dsl cycle: dsl's only dependency on vcs is itself a dev-dependency). Added `#[cfg(test)] extern crate self as vcs;` (same pattern dsl/rs/lib.rs already uses) so the derive macros' hardcoded `::vcs::` paths resolve in-crate. Updated the 4 existing hand-format-dependent tests to the new "n=0"/"set-n n=1" derive-engine wire format instead of the old hand-rolled "n 0"/"set-n 1".

3. DONE — Added `FolderEndpoint::Text { storage: vcs::FolderTextStorage, document_id, extension }` in framework/sync/rs/lib.rs, wired through build_folder_endpoint (any path with a file extension → Text; extensionless directory → Sqlite, generalizing the old .json-only special case) and folder_watch_path_for. Migrated both confirmed FileJsonStorage dependents (framework/sync itself, framework/product/os/core's StudioPortKind::File) onto FolderTextStorage, deriving folder/document_id/extension from the path. Deleted FileJsonStorage entirely from vcs/rs/lib.rs (confirmed zero remaining references) plus its now-redundant test (superseded by the existing folder_text_storage_round_trips_dsl_and_appends_ops test). Documented limitation: both actors are serde_json::Value-typed end to end (no concrete Projection/Operation), so they store the whole-envelope JSON in FolderTextStorage's .dsl slot and write the sibling .ops file empty — full per-operation text persistence would need a larger actor redesign, out of scope here.

4. DONE — Added `document_text`/`load_document_text`/`ingest_operations_text` to PluginApp trait + VcsDocumentApp impl in framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Deliberately used `vcs::DocumentTextFiles` (not a bespoke single-string format) for document_text/load_document_text since that struct is already the canonical two-file text representation everywhere else in the codebase. ingest_operations_text applies each op-text line as a fresh LOCAL edit via DocumentVcsCommand::Apply (not the JSON path's remote-DAG ingest_remote), since bare op-text lines carry no envelope/actor/id metadata. Kept the JSON methods (document_json/load_document/ingest_operations) — did not remove them, per the survey's own prioritization, since the TS renderer still depends on them (item 9). Updated framework/wit/world.wit: new `document-text-files` record type plus `apply-operations-text`/`read-app-document-text`/`load-app-document-text` functions. Wired the WIT Guest impl (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's `component` module) and the corresponding plugin_runtime glue functions (plugin_ingest_operations_text/plugin_document_text/plugin_load_document_text), AND the wasmtime host-side wrapper methods in framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs. Verified the wasm32-wasip2 component actually compiles (`cargo build -p semio-framework-plugin --target wasm32-wasip2`, clean) and the host crate compiles natively (clean) — both boundaries, not just the trait signature.

5. DONE — Added three new PolicyRule regions to script.ts's 🔖Policy region, wired into the existing `policy` lint export:
   - PolicyRuleNoJsonFixtures: forbids new */example/*.json files repo-wide; POLICY_JSON_FIXTURE_ALLOWLIST covers the 5 real not-yet-migrated technologies (forms, s, lowpoly, gis/2d, dag) found in the live tree; coda/ excluded structurally (its example/ holds unrelated ACC-project run artifacts, not a technology document fixture).
   - PolicyRuleOpsGrammar: forward-looking structural check for *.ops files (one @doc/@edit/@change/@checkpoint/@alternative/@active line or one 2-space-indented op-text line per line, never blank) — no *.ops files exist yet so currently a no-op, ready when one lands.
   - PolicyRuleDslCompleteness: repo-wide scan finding every `impl DocumentApp for X` and checking its Projection/Operation type has a #[derive(dsl::Dsl...)] or hand-rolled impl DocumentDsl/OpText, recognizing derive attributes (not just hand-written impls) as satisfying the check per the original design intent; also resolves `RealName as AliasName` import-rename chains (e.g. forms's ProtocolSpec as FormSpec, raster/plugin's RasterProjection as RasterDocument) so those don't false-positive. Rewrote the completeness check from an initial O(usages × files) design (which hung/timed out) to a single O(total content) pass building the complete-type-name sets once. Verified via an isolated bun script invoking `policy` directly: 0 dsl-migration/* breaches (all real gaps fixed in item 1, all false positives from aliasing resolved); confirmed `bun ./script.ts policy` runs without runtime errors (exits 1 only due to 32 pre-existing, unrelated Wave-4 audit breaches already in the tree before this session — verified via git diff that I never touched those files/lines).

6. DONE — Ran `bun ./script.ts generate` then `bun ./script.ts check` inside framework/plugin/registry: catalog was already fresh (33 plugin crates, 50 playgrounds) — the trait/WIT signature changes don't affect what the registry scans (Cargo.toml metadata), so no generated files changed. Both commands ran clean.

7. CONFIRMED NO-OP — No new interactively-launched dev command was introduced (only trait methods, a lint rule, and a Cargo dev-dependency); .vscode/launch.json already has the relevant plugin-registry:generate entry from before. Left untouched.

8. DONE — Added `HistoryView.recent_ops: Vec<String>` (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs), populated in build_history_view via the last 20 applied operations' OpText::print_op text (newest first, HISTORY_VIEW_RECENT_OPS_LIMIT=20). Fixed the resulting 8 downstream HistoryView struct-literal construction sites across fem/plugin, s/plugin (x2), cad/plugin, architect/plugin, remodel/plugin, mathematical/plugin (x2) that needed the new field.

9. DEFERRED, as recommended — the TS renderer's ~30 documentJson references across framework/renderer/react/index.tsx, framework/renderer/wgpu/js/boot.ts, and the Storybook story stay as-is: since item 4 kept (not removed) the JSON methods, renaming documentJson→documentDsl now would be premature and purely cosmetic (nothing forces it yet), and a partial rename would leave the renderer inconsistent.

Final verification: `cargo build --workspace` clean (CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-lockstep-target). `cargo test` clean (beyond the 4 pre-flagged unrelated failures + the pervasive icon-catalog panic + 2 newly-found-but-verified-unrelated flaky/pre-existing tests) for every crate this ticket touched or fixed: vcs, vcs-plugin, protocol-module-procedural, fem-plugin, trinity-plugin, puzzle-plugin, dag-plugin, forms-plugin, semio-framework-plugin, semio-framework-plugin-host, semio-framework-sync, semio-framework-os. A full `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` was also run; it was still executing (deep in the slow symbolic-math `mathematical` crate test suite) when this ticket closed, after already surfacing only expected/known-unrelated failures across ~15 crates checked so far (compose's own unrelated GraphQL/kit-store bugs, the pervasive icon-catalog panic, the 4 pre-flagged bugs). `bun ./script.ts verify gate` (dependency-cruiser, registry freshness, region/host-contract lints, leveled-test-target coverage) passes clean.
